name: Spell Striker
extDescription: This card can be Special Summoned by removing 1 Spell Card in your Graveyard from play. This card can attack your opponent's Life Points directly. Battle Damage to this card's controller from a battle involving this card becomes 0.

name: Exploder Dragon
extDescription: When this card is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard as a result of battle, destroy the monster that destroyed this card. When this card attacks, Battle Damage to both players as a result of that battle is reduced to 0.

name: Destiny HERO - Disk Commander
extDescription: When this card is Special Summoned from your Graveyard, draw 2 cards.
